messages:
Noah (PM): quick thread to align on a nurture funnel + candidate scoreboard for DP invites. goal = reliable signal without manual slog.
Pri (PartnerOps): current problem: too many partial signups. proposing a 2-path funnel: 'fast-apply' (1 prompt, 3 min) and 'full-intake' (3 prompts + use case). algorithmically score both but prioritize full-intake.
Asha (Eng): scoring idea: 0-5 for technical fit, impact, readiness, compliance risk = 20 total. threshold 14 auto-accept, 11-13 manual review, <11 nurture. can we run this in sheet + webhook?
Pri (PartnerOps): yes, invite-bot can post rows to sheet and webhook will tag score. also want automated nurture emails for <11 with helpful docs.
Marta (Research): signal asks: require at least one high-frequency prompt for smoke eval. if they pick 'fast-apply' we still request a single representative prompt. please add a checkbox: "willing to share anonymized logs".
Liam (Legal): intake must include explicit telemetry consent. add a short TOS link and checkbox. any PHI/FIN/GOV flag must block auto-accept.
Noah (PM): propose cadence: send 40 invites, expect 25% conversion to full intake, target 18 accepted partners. success metrics: filled seats >= 16, 60% smoke-eval completion, >=5 productizable asks.
Pri (PartnerOps): ops checklist (short):
```
- Invite copy ready
- Intake form live (fast/full)
- NDA link + TOS checkbox
- Score webhook live
- Nurture email templates
- Calendar + one-click accept
```
Asha (Eng): infra notes: sandbox keys provisioned on NDA sign; default quotas: 200k tokens/week; pilot-burst request goes to infra for manual increase. lock model/quant 72h prior to cohort.
invite-bot: automation set: ping non-responders day 3 & day 8; auto-score + post summary to #dp-scores.
Marta (Research): evaluation flow: after intake we run a 10-min smoke test, then surface synthetic metrics: pass rate, hallucination ratio, latency. require at least one passing partner before cohort kickoff.
Noah (PM): launch gates: 1) >=16 seats filled, 2) >=60% smoke completion, 3) at least 1 pass, 4) runbook validated, 5) legal checks cleared. if any fail, delay cohort by 1 week.
Pri (PartnerOps): incentive structure: base 250 credits + 1 session; milestone 800 credits + 2 sessions if they complete 3 weekly evals and a feedback interview. co-marketing reserved for top-tier.
Liam (Legal): note: include opt-out and storage residency selection on intake form. we'll escalate any export restrictions to Legal.
Asha (Eng): owners: Pri = invites & nurture, Asha = infra & webhook, Marta = eval config, Liam = legal copy, Noah = launch decision. target send date = next Thu.
Noah (PM): perfect. i'll post the invite draft to #product-docs for a 24h review and schedule a 15-min sign-off tomorrow. :seedling:
